selection: First 15 published self_hostable apps with an empty install-options array, slug beginning d, e, or f, ordered by slug.

apps.name: dasher

verified_options.label: Native installation
verified_options.note: The project README instructs users to install dependencies, clone the project, and run npm install. The project is sunsetted and relies on legacy Amazon Dash buttons.

sources.note: Official README says the project is sunsetted and describes the host installation steps.

gaps_or_updates_needed: An install option can be added for the documented native setup.
Keep the sunset status clear; verify the app remains useful before further enrichment.

apps.name: Datasette

verified_options.label: Native installation
verified_options.note: The official install guide documents pip and pipx installation.

sources.note: Official guide documents the Docker Hub image and pip/pipx installation.
Docker Hub listing identifies datasetteproject/datasette and has a current latest tag.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Replace docker_url, which currently points to a Dockerfile, with the Docker Hub registry URL.
Set docker_image to datasetteproject/datasette and include native installation in deployment_methods.

apps.name: dayGLANCE

sources.note: Official self-hosting guide provides a Docker Compose configuration and names the GHCR image.
Official getting-started page links self-hosted installation and provides a Compose quick start.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Add docker_url, docker_image, compose_url, and docker/compose deployment methods from the official guide.

apps.name: Daytona

sources.note: The README points to a full local Docker Compose stack and says this stack is still in development and is not safe to use in production.
The official Compose directory README calls this a local development setup; the linked production deployment guide returns 404.
The repository's official open-source deployment link currently returns 404.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Do not publish a Compose install option from the dev-only stack.
The current docker_url points to a repository tag rather than an install destination.
Verify a supported self-host deployment route with the publisher; current official deployment documentation is unavailable.

apps.name: ddclient

verified_options.label: System package
verified_options.note: The official README recommends installing a package offered by the operating system and documents manual installation as an alternative.

sources.note: Official README describes OS package installation and links to project releases.
Official site links to the project documentation.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Add a package install option and set deployment_methods to include package.
No official Docker image was verified; do not use the LinuxServer community image as an official destination.

apps.name: DDraceNetwork

verified_options.label: System package
verified_options.note: The official README gives package-manager install commands. The official maps repository says the DDNet-Server binary is distributed with the DDNet client and can run an independent server.

sources.note: Official README provides install commands for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, FreeBSD, macOS, and Windows.
Official maps README says users can run their own server with the DDNet-Server binary distributed with the DDNet client.
Official downloads page lists DDNet builds and packages.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Remove the Dockerfile URL from docker_url; no official Docker image or Compose deployment was verified.
Replace the docker deployment method with package, and link to official server setup guidance if a dedicated server guide is added.

apps.name: Decypharr

verified_options.label: Docker image
verified_options.note: The official installation guide and Docker Hub listing use this image.

verified_options.label: Docker Compose
verified_options.note: Official guide provides a Compose service and the cy01/blackhole image.

verified_options.label: Binary release
verified_options.note: The official guide says to download the Linux binary from GitHub Releases.

sources.note: Official guide documents Docker Compose, Docker Run, and Linux binary installation.

Official guide identifies GitHub Releases as the binary download destination.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Replace docker_url with the Docker Hub registry URL and set docker_image to cy01/blackhole:latest.
Add the Compose and binary install options.

apps.name: deltafin

verified_options.note: Official instructions install the app in a Python virtual environment and build native libraries on the host.

sources.note: Official README has a New installation procedure.
Official requirements document states supported host platforms and disk needs.

apps.name: DePay

sources.note: Official guide installs @depay/widgets as an npm/yarn dependency or loads it from a CDN for embedding in another application.
The linked source project is a widget library, not an independently deployable server app.

gaps_or_updates_needed: No independent self-hosted app installation was verified; the official install path is a JavaScript widget bundled into another app.
Review self_hosting_status and directory eligibility before adding an install option.

apps.name: DietPi

verified_options.label: Native installation
verified_options.note: DietPi is installed from official disk images on supported single-board computers or native PCs.

sources.note: Official guide explains downloading and flashing a DietPi image for supported hardware.
Official homepage offers image downloads and identifies DietPi as a Debian-based operating system.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Replace deployment_methods docker with native; DietPi is an operating system distributed as disk images.

apps.name: Dify.ai

verified_options.label: Docker Compose
verified_options.note: The official self-host guide starts the full multi-service stack with Docker Compose.

sources.note: Official guide provides self-host installation steps and current Compose requirements.
Official project README also directs self-hosters to Docker Compose.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Replace deployment_methods native with compose.
Do not create a single Docker image option: the official installation uses a multi-service Compose stack.

apps.name: Digger

verified_options.label: Helm chart
verified_options.note: The guide installs the digger-backend Helm chart from the publisher's OCI chart registry.

sources.note: Official deployment instructions show a helm install command for digger-backend and its OCI chart.
The old official docs URL redirects to the OpenTaco documentation, which identifies a product rebrand.
GitHub Packages lists the publisher's digger_backend container image.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Update install_docs_url to the current official guide; the stored GitHub MDX path is stale.
The official docs now say OpenTaco; review the directory name, product identity, and official website links.
Replace the docker deployment method with helm. The current source confirms a Helm route; it does not justify a bare Docker method.

apps.name: Discourse

verified_options.label: Docker image
verified_options.note: Official setup uses Docker and the Discourse installer builds the application container; the guide does not offer one pullable application image.

sources.note: Official install overview says only Docker-based self-host installs are supported.
Official install guide provides the current one-command Docker installer for a local or cloud Linux server.

gaps_or_updates_needed: Add the official Docker installation option and set deployment_methods to docker.
Link to the installation guide, not a presumed Docker Hub app image; Discourse builds and manages its Docker image through its installer.
